<translated_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class TaskE {
public:
    class MinCostMaxFlow {
    public:
        struct Edge {
            int u, flow, cost, rid;
            Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d) : u(a), flow(b), cost(c), rid(d) {}
        };

        vector<vector<Edge>> al;
        vector<vector<Edge>> ja;
        vector<int> d;
        int N, S, T, maxFlow, minCost;
        const int gmax = INT_MAX / 100;

        MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int source, int sink) {
            N = n; S = source; T = sink; maxFlow = 0; minCost = 0;
            al.resize(N);
            d.assign(N, 0);
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
            int lu = al[u].size(), lv = al[v].size();
            al[u].push_back(Edge(v, flow, cost, lv));
            al[v].push_back(Edge(u, 0, -cost, lu));
        }

        void convertToArray() {
            ja.resize(N);
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                ja[i] = al[i];
                al[i].clear();
            }
        }

        bool BellmanFord(bool check) {
            fill(d.begin(), d.end(), gmax);
            d[0] = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                    for (const Edge& e : ja[j]) {
                        if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                        if (d[j] + e.cost < d[e.u]) {
                            d[e.u] = d[j] + e.cost;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (check) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                    for (const Edge& e : ja[j]) {
                        if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                        if (d[j] + e.cost < d[e.u]) return false;
                    }
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        vector<int> node, visit, prv, prve, dist;

        bool simple() {
            node.assign(N, 0);
            visit.assign(N, 0);
            prv.assign(N, 0);
            prve.assign(N, 0);
            dist.assign(N, gmax);

            node[0] = S; dist[0] = 0;
            int front = 1, back = 0;
            while (front != back) {
                int u = node[back++];
                int distu = dist[u];
                if (back == N) back = 0;
                visit[u] = 2;
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[u].size(); i++) {
                    Edge& e = ja[u][i];
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    int cdist = distu + e.cost;
                    if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                        if (visit[e.u] == 0) {
                            node[front] = e.u;
                            if (++front == N) front = 0;
                        } else if (visit[e.u] == 2) {
                            if (--back == -1) back += N;
                            node[back] = e.u;
                        }
                        visit[e.u] = 1;
                        prve[e.u] = i; prv[e.u] = u; dist[e.u] = cdist;
                    }
                }
            }
            return visit[T] != 0;
        }

        struct pair_t {
            int F, S;
            pair_t(int a, int b) : F(a), S(b) {}
        };

        struct cmp {
            bool operator()(const pair_t& a, const pair_t& b) {
                return a.S > b.S; // min-heap based on S
            }
        };

        bool dijkstra() {
            visit.assign(N, 0);
            prv.assign(N, 0);
            prve.assign(N, 0);
            dist.assign(N, gmax);
            priority_queue<pair_t, vector<pair_t>, cmp> pq;

            pq.push(pair_t(S, 0)); dist[0] = 0;
            while (!pq.empty()) {
                pair_t p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
                while (dist[p.F] < p.S) {
                    if (pq.empty()) break;
                    p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
                }
                visit[p.F] = 2;
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[p.F].size(); i++) {
                    Edge& e = ja[p.F][i];
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    int cdist = p.S + (e.cost + d[p.F] - d[e.u]);
                    if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                        if (visit[e.u] == 2) return false;
                        pq.push(pair_t(e.u, cdist));
                        dist[e.u] = cdist; prv[e.u] = p.F; prve[e.u] = i;
                        visit[e.u] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            return visit[T] != 0;
        }

        int augment() {
            int p = T;
            int minf = gmax;
            while (p != 0) {
                int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
                int val = ja[pp][pe].flow;
                minf = min(minf, val);
                p = pp;
            }
            p = T;
            while (p != 0) {
                int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
                ja[pp][pe].flow -= minf;
                ja[p][ja[pp][pe].rid].flow += minf;
                p = pp;
            }
            maxFlow += minf;
            return minf;
        }

        bool calSimple() {
            while (simple()) {
                minCost += dist[T] * augment();
            }
            return true;
        }

        void updPotential() {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                if (visit[i] != 0) {
                    d[i] += dist[i] - dist[S];
                }
            }
        }

        bool calWithPotential() {
            while (dijkstra()) {
                int minf = dist[T] + d[T] - d[S];
                minCost += minf * augment();
                updPotential();
            }
            return true;
        }
    };

    int n, m, k, c, d;
    vector<int> a, f;

    void solve(int testNumber, istream& in, ostream& out) {
        in >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
        int maxl = n + k;
        int T = n * maxl + 1;
        MinCostMaxFlow ans(T + 1, 0, T);
        a.resize(k + 1);
        f.assign(n + 1, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            in >> a[i];
            f[a[i]]++;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (f[i] == 0) continue;
            ans.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
                ans.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int a, b;
            in >> a >> b;
            for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
                for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                    if (a != 1)
                        ans.addEdge(n * l + a, n * (l + 1) + b, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                    if (b != 1)
                        ans.addEdge(n * l + b, n * (l + 1) + a, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int l = 1; l < maxl; l++) {
            ans.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
        }
        ans.convertToArray();
        ans.calSimple();
        if (ans.maxFlow != k) {
            out << "BUG" << endl;
        } else {
            out << (int)ans.minCost << endl;
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    TaskE solver;
    solver.solve(1, cin, cout);
    return 0;
}
